turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a and an?
turns.tutor:
Sure! First, one example. Look at "egg". It starts with the sound "e", so I write "an egg". Look at "cat". It starts with the sound "k", so I write "a cat".
Rule: use an before a vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u), and a before other sounds.
Right: I ate an egg. Wrong: I ate a egg.
Now your turn. Write the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
